title: 第26章 出事了
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
“你留下。”

    “你。”

    “你。”

    “还有你！”

    李西朋是真的绝，李西海换一批，他就留一个或者两个。

    颜值身材都是高质量的。

    白宫会所这消费，公主质量就不可能低，扎根在林江最顶尖的会所层次，资源不会少的。

    只是李西海都没有看上眼的。

    李西雄跟李西英都有点整不会了。

    李西海的眼光真的有点挑啊。

    领队没什么表示，一直都在换，但心里也在嘀咕。

    好在白宫会所的资源多。

    换一批还有。

    但这么换，耽误时间。

    李西雄道：“西海，我跟领班说一声，直接去花房挑。”

    “花房？”

    “公主休息室。”

    李西海一听意动了，但摇了摇头，道：“再换一批看看。”

    “行。”

    又是一批。

    他总算是有一个看上的，定了下来。

    这下。

    包厢灯光暗淡，音乐响起。

    正式开始嗨皮。

    酒水一开，公主们主动倒酒。

    李西海搂着公主，举杯一起喝了一个。

    “你叫什么？”

    “阿知。”

    李西海并不是什么雏，也不是什么圣人。

    到了娱乐场所，你消费了就该享受。

    李西雄有句话说的很好，把自己当人的不要，把客人当人的也不要。

    把自己当人还怎么玩？

    就是要最野性最狂欢的。

    “去。”

    “跳舞。”

    “跳得好的，每个人都有事小费。”

    李西朋喊道。

    这家伙不知道从哪里掏出来，一大叠现钱，就这么摆放在桌子上。

    翘着二郎腿，叼着烟，搂着公主，躺在沙发上，摆着豪放的架势。

    “卧槽。”

    “你这会玩啊。”

    李西雄不无震惊的说道。

    显然是被李西朋这一手给亮到了。

    李西英道：“西朋，可以的。”

    “哈哈。”

    “基操，基操。”
content_en:
"You stay."

    "You."

    "You."

    "And you!"

    Li Xipeng is really amazing. When Li Xihai changes a batch, he will keep one or two.

    The appearance and figure are of high quality.

    For the consumption of the White House Club, the quality of Princess cannot be low. It is rooted in the top club level in Linjiang, and there will be no shortage of resources.

    It's just that Li Xihai didn't take any fancy to him.

    Li Xixiong and Li Xiying are both a bit confused.

    Li Xihai's vision is really picky.

    The team leader didn't say anything and kept changing, but he was also muttering in his heart.

    Fortunately, the White House Club has many resources.

    Another batch is available.

    But changing it this way will waste time.

    Li Xixiong said: "Xihai, I'll tell the foreman and go directly to the flower room to pick it up."

    "Flower room?"

    "Princess Lounge."

    Li Xihai was moved when he heard this, but shook his head and said, "Let's try another batch."

    "Okay."

    Another batch.

    He finally found one he liked and settled on it.

    This time.

    The lights in the box were dimmed and the music was playing.

    The fun officially started.

    As soon as the drinks were opened, the princesses took the initiative to pour them.

    Li Xihai hugged the princess, raised glasses and drank one together.

    "What's your name?"

    "Azhi."

    Li Xihai is neither a young boy nor a saint.

    When you arrive at an entertainment venue, you should enjoy it after spending it.

    Li Xixiong has a saying that is very good: don’t treat yourself as a human being, and don’t want someone who treats your guests as a human being.

    How can you play when you treat yourself as a human being?

    Just want to be the most wild and carnival.

    "Go."

    "Dance."

    "Good dance, everyone has something to tip."

    Li Xipeng shouted.

    This guy took it out from nowhere, and placed a large stack of cash on the table.

    He crossed his legs, held a cigarette in his mouth, hugged the princess, and lay on the sofa in a bold and bold posture.

    "Fuck."

    "You know how to play."

    Li Xixiong said in shock.

    Apparently he was impressed by Li Xipeng's move.

    Li Xiying said: "Xipeng, it's okay."

    "Haha."

    "Basic work, basic work."
